question: Did a Microsoft ASP.NET AJAX request for the selected USAF 63-32 folder return the actual image rather than just viewer markup?
independence: Same SGB archive session and catalogue lineage as CGEO-29/30; additional technical observation, not a new historical witness.
interpretive_limits: An HTTP 200 AJAX delta with an empty img src is proof only of the returned panel, not that the archival image does not exist.
The selected folder label and its /1 page counter are not an image asset, an exposure count or a capture date.
No PDF or photograph bytes were acquired; rendering might require a different browser request, access condition, or backend handler.
The USAF 63-32 archival lineage is not automatically identical to PETROBRAS 53 D/1961.
next_test: Capture a real browser network log on a resource-adequate executor and identify any separate image-handler request; validate bytes, source, scale and flight-footprint before interpreting it.
